summary: Confirmed on koa.com: 50-amp max, open all year, pool/hot tub, paid Wi-Fi, store, shower houses, online and phone booking with sites assigned on arrival. Fees left as AWH's manual read (Feb 2027: $104.50 back-in full hookup to $156.75 lakeside); not re-quoted. Note trimmed of those rate figures. Not stated: site count, max rig length, pull-throughs, minimum stay.
flags: Long-stay check: the park pushes winter-season and annual extended stays ('Come spend the winter season with us', 'Stay All Season & Become An Annual!'), but nightly RV stays are sold online on koa.com and recent reviews describe one-night stays, so it passes. Family-proximity exception applies; no price gate.
